about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the world of Aurora Polaris through its evocative original soundtrack. Composed to accompany each stage and character, these tracks blend retro arcade energy with cinematic atmospheres and emotional depth.

🎧 Includes 10+ high-quality MP3 tracks
🌀 Features dynamic battle themes, ambient stage layers, and character motifs
🔓 Available as DLC – requires the base game Aurora Polaris on Steam
